_doc: Equivalence-prover allowlist. Every entry acknowledges an INTENDED divergence between the current tree and validation/baselines/v68. Entries require file (repo-relative), reason, and wave (e.g. v6.9). The prover fails on any un-allowlisted diff and on any stale entry whose file no longer diverges.
